summary: Evolution decision commands (review/approve/reject/execute) now derive actor_id and actor_role from the verified principal (auth.policy.extract_identity) via command_adapters.evolution_adapter.resolve_evolution_actor (mfa_token threaded through so MFA-required environments resolve); mismatching client actor_id/approved_by_id or unheld actor_role/approved_by_role -> 403 with nothing sent. Default role is chosen only among held roles (reviewer_on_duty in preference order). test_admin dev login gains reviewer_on_duty; unused divergent _DEV_LOGIN_IDENTITY_DEFS copy removed from personas/service.py. Evolution service unchanged.
notes: Default role preference keeps risk_owner ahead of reviewer_on_duty, so test_admin must name actor_role=reviewer_on_duty for LOW-risk decisions (H4); clients that name no role still get the previous highest-authority held role.
